parsed_entries.requirement: The Board shall determine whether there are sufficient grounds to proceed with an inquiry.

parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the Board's responsibility to assess the validity of inquiries related to data protection compliance.

parsed_entries.requirement: Any person aggrieved by an order or direction made by the Board under this Act may prefer an appeal before the Appellate Tribunal.

parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.

parsed_entries.requirement: Every appeal under sub-section (1) shall be filed within a period of sixty days from the date of receipt of the order or direction appealed against.
